title: The Strange noise in the roof
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：strange　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 strange 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the elder wrote of ① a strange noise in the roof in the memoir, and everybody in the village said at once that it was ② stranger than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the elder, who never explained anything, had done it with great care and gone home; it was the strange ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the strangest noise in the roof anybody in the village had ever seen, or so the memoir for November 1958 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too strange to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the youth who had come to help; the strange ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a strange man at the door, and said that no youth in his right mind would call it ⑥ as strange as the man at the door they had once had in the old village. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was strange or not, and he said so.

By 1971 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the memoir. What the line asked for was ⑦ something strange, and nothing besides. The youth from the next village called the whole plan ⑧ quite strange; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the memoir kept the names of the strange ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1974, on the same day, she wrote of another strange noise in the roof in the same memoir, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ stranger than anybody had expected. ⑩ The strangest man at the door in the whole village, she said in 1976, was the one she could never quite name; the strange ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 奇怪（前置定语 a strange noise in the roof：1964 年长者在回忆录里记下的那件奇怪的声响）
B. adj. 奇怪／陌生（比较级 stranger than：文中两处，一处比屋顶上奇怪的声响，一处比预想）
C. adj. 奇怪／陌生（最高级 the strangest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 奇怪（表语 too strange to do：母亲觉得它太奇怪，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 陌生（前置定语 a strange man at the door：叔叔把整件事称作一桩陌生的男人）
F. adj. 陌生（同级比较 as strange as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩门口陌生的男人相比）
G. adj. 陌生（后置定语 something strange：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 陌生（受程度副词修饰 quite strange：那位后生的评价）

items.q: a strange noise in the roof
the strangest noise in the roof anybody
a strange man at the door
The strangest man at the door in

answers.why: strange 意为“奇怪”，1964 年长者在回忆录里记下的是“一件奇怪的声响”，此处作前置定语 a strange noise in the roof。
strange 意为“奇怪”，此处用比较级 stranger than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
strange 意为“奇怪”，回忆录上 十一月 那行字说它是村子里最奇怪的一件，故用最高级 the strangest noise in the roof。
strange 意为“奇怪”，母亲认为这件东西“太奇怪了，谁也用不上”，too strange to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
strange 意为“陌生”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩陌生的男人”，此处作前置定语 a strange man at the door。
strange 意为“陌生”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩门口陌生的男人一样陌生”，同级比较用 as strange as。
strange 意为“陌生”，回忆录上那半行字要的是“陌生的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something strange。
strange 意为“陌生”，邻村子来的那位后生认为这套计划“相当陌生”，quite 修饰原级 strange。
strange 意为“陌生”，1974 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要陌生”，故用比较级 stranger than。
strange 意为“陌生”，母亲 1976 年说的是“整个村子里最陌生的那一桩”，故用最高级 the strangest man at the door。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1964 年，长者在回忆录里记下了一件奇怪的声响。（a strange noise in the roof）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更奇怪。（stranger than …）
母亲觉得它太奇怪，谁也用不上。（too strange to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩陌生的男人。（a strange man at the door）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩门口陌生的男人一样陌生。（as strange as …）
到了 1971 年，回忆录上只剩半行字：要的是一件陌生的东西。（something strange）
answers: In 1964 the elder wrote of a strange noise in the roof in the memoir.
Everybody said it was stranger than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too strange to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a strange man at the door.
He said nobody would call it as strange as the man at the door they had once had.
By 1971 the memoir asked for nothing but something strange.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 strange 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1964 the elder wrote of a strange noise in the roof in the memoir, and nobody forgot it.
It was the strangest noise in the roof in the village, or so the memoir says.
My mother thought it too strange to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a strange man at the door, and nobody argued with him.
The youth from the next village called the plan quite strange, and everybody laughed.
The strange ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
